categories.main_business_segments: AECOM operates through three main business segments: Americas, International, and AECOM Capital (ACAP). The Americas segment provides planning, consulting, architectural and engineering design, construction management, and program management services in the United States, Canada, and Latin America. The International segment offers similar services across Europe, the Middle East, India, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. AECOM Capital primarily invests in and develops real estate projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AECOM leverages advanced engineering, architectural, and digital technologies, including AI-driven design, digital project management platforms, and data analytics to deliver infrastructure solutions. The company emphasizes innovative design processes, sustainability, and resilience in its project delivery, and utilizes multidisciplinary teams for complex program and construction management. Its methods span the full asset lifecycle, from advisory and planning to design, construction management, and operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AECOM serves a diverse client base including national, state, and local governments, public and private institutions, and major corporations. Key end markets include transportation (transit, rail, highways, aviation), water (treatment, supply, drought mitigation), environmental (remediation, permitting), energy (renewables, transmission), facilities (government, commercial, healthcare, education, sports), and real estate development. No single client accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with significant presence in the Americas (U.S., Canada, Latin America), Europe, the Middle East, India, Africa, and the Asia-Australia-Pacific regions. Approximately 27% of revenue is generated outside the United States, and AECOM maintains offices and project sites worldwide to serve local and international clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: AECOM is positioned as a downstream provider in the infrastructure supply chain, focusing on professional services such as consulting, design, engineering, and program management. It does not manufacture physical products but manages projects, often acting as a prime contractor or lead consultant, and coordinates with subcontractors and joint venture partners for project execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: AECOM's strategic priorities include expanding its leadership in infrastructure consulting, investing in digital and AI-driven solutions, and enhancing sustainability and resilience in project delivery. The company is focused on continuous improvement, margin expansion, and leveraging its global technical expertise to address complex infrastructure challenges. Innovation in digital platforms and data-driven design is a key R&D theme.
categories.revenue_model: AECOM primarily generates revenue through fee-based, knowledge-based services, billing clients for employee time on projects and managing project costs. Revenue streams include cost-reimbursable contracts, guaranteed maximum price contracts, and fixed-price contracts. AECOM Capital earns income from real estate development sales and management fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AECOM competes with a large number of regional, national, and international firms in the highly fragmented professional services and infrastructure consulting industry. Major competitors include Jacobs, WSP, SNC-Lavalin, and Stantec. AECOM is positioned as the largest general architectural and engineering design firm globally, with leading rankings in water, transportation, facilities, and environmental markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2025, AECOM reported revenue of $16.1 billion, with a net income attributable to AECOM of $561.8 million and a backlog of $39.7 billion. The company employs approximately 51,000 people and has demonstrated steady growth, with revenue increasing slightly year-over-year and gross profit margins improving. The company maintains a strong balance sheet and significant liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AECOM differentiates itself through its global scale, technical expertise, and ability to deliver end-to-end solutions across the infrastructure lifecycle. Its investments in digital and AI capabilities, commitment to sustainability, and integrated multidisciplinary teams enable innovative, efficient, and resilient project outcomes. The company emphasizes its reputation, long-term client relationships, and ability to solve complex infrastructure challenges as key value drivers.
